snippet.title: Bolt Action | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the boots of a battlefield commander in Bolt Action, a turn-based WWII
strategy inspired by Warlord Games’ tabletop classic.
The game brings the miniature battlefield to life in a fully 3D environment, featuring
realistic line of sight, terrain, and morale mechanics.
Bolt Action offers a dynamic single-player campaign set during D-Day and the
battles of Normandy, alongside multiplayer modes. Players must make careful
tactical decisions, positioning troops, timing attacks, and issuing orders to achieve
victory.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856030/Bolt_Action/
